subject: Renewal + EU onshore + APAC pilot: scope, pricing, and failover
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solacehealth.io>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + EU/APAC expansion needs

Hi Ben,

We kicked off our renewal planning this week and wanted to raise a couple of items early so we can align before contract talks. Our current Redwood subscription (pooled hosted) is up for renewal on 2026-07-15. Over the last 12 months usage has grown ~2.5x and we have two new asks:

- EU onshore deployment: legal requires EU data residency for PHI-adjacent features (GDPR + local contracts). We need a plan and timeline to migrate inference and logs to an EU region with confirmed data residency and audit logging.
- APAC pilot & burst capacity: product is being piloted in Singapore in Q4. We need burst routing to APAC for 6 months with predictable cold-start limits, and a cross-region failover for EU→APAC when EU capacity spikes.

High-level asks: updated pricing for these options over a 2-year renewal (we're open to committed capacity), SLA on failover behavior, and an indicative SOW for the migration and pilot. Can you loop in the right folks?

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Eng
Solace Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU/APAC expansion needs

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the usage growth.

We can support both items; looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Aditya (solutions) to scope and cost. Quick answers up front:
- EU onshore: we have a private EU tenancy option + data residency controls. Migration can be done with minimal downtime using our prefix cache warm-up plan; expect 4–8 week lead time depending on contract and provisioning.
- APAC pilot/burst: we can provide burst pools in APAC and configure routing policies for burst and failover. Pricing depends on committed baseline and burst cap.

Next step: Marissa/Aditya — can you put together a draft SOW and a 2-year pricing scenario (committed vs. pay-as-you-go with burst)? Alicia — would you share any compliance checklist or SSO/KMS requirements you need?

Best,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@solacehealth.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solacehealth.io>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU/APAC expansion needs

Thanks Ben — attaching the high-level compliance checklist we use. A few clarifications from engineering:

- EU residency must include encryption-at-rest keys under our KMS and an audit log stream retained 7 years.
- Failover behavior: we need documented cold-starts (max 300ms extra latency) and a policy that failover only routes to APAC when EU utilization > 85% for >60s or on explicit manual override.
- APAC pilot: target start window is 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31; during pilot we need a 10x burst headroom for 60-second intervals and tagging for cost allocation.

Happy to jump on a 30–45 minute call to walk the teams through the details.

Alicia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft SOW + initial pricing scenarios (attached)

Alicia — thanks for the checklist. I put together a draft SOW and two pricing scenarios:

1) Committed 24-month: includes EU onshore environment (reserved GPU pool), APAC burst pool (capacity reserve for pilot), and managed migration. 15% discount on list for the commitment, includes SOC2 evidence package and 7-year audit log retention in EU tenancy.
2) Hybrid (12-month commit + burst credits): lower upfront, higher unit costs for burst; useful if you want flexibility after the pilot.

I've attached: SOW_Solace_v2.pdf, pricing_apac_burst.xlsx, and SOC2-summary.pdf.

Key technical notes:
- Migration window estimate: 3–6 weeks from signature depending on KMS onboarding cadence.
- Failover policy: we can implement the 85%/60s threshold, and we can provide a manual failover play in the console. Cold-start penalty depends on model profile; we'll include per-model expectations in the final SOW.

Can we schedule a technical sync next week? I also included Monica (onboarding lead) who will own the migration runbook.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Solace_v2.pdf (application/pdf), pricing_apac_burst.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + initial pricing scenarios (technical notes)

Alicia — quick technical notes to complement the SOW:

- KMS integration: we support AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault. If you have an on-prem HSM, we can do an HSM-backed KMIP integration but that adds provisioning lead time (2–3 weeks). Please confirm which KMS.
- Audit logs: we will stream structured audit logs to your EU logging account (S3/GCS compatible). Retention policy may incur storage charges beyond the committed plan — included in the pricing sheet as an opt-in item.
- Failover mechanics: traffic steering uses weighted routing at the LB level with health checks. When utilization threshold is reached, routing shifts gradually (5% increments every 10s) until failover target achieves target p95 latency. We will include a runbook for emergency manual redirect.

I'll prepare a short appendix to add model-specific cold-start expectations for your two primary models.

-Aditya
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solacehealth.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@solacehealth.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solacehealth.io>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + initial pricing scenarios (procurement ready)

Team — internal execs have greenlit a 24-month committed renewal if the total goes under our internal TCO threshold. We reviewed the committed scenario and have two asks before we route to legal:

1) Can you update the quote to show a blended unit price with the 15% commitment discount and a separate line for APAC burst credits (so we can budget against the pilot)?
2) Add a clause in the SOW for a 30-day rollback of the EU migration in case there are unforeseen integration issues (reasonable support effort, capped at 40 hours at T&M).

If you can push an updated SOW + redline to DocuSign by EOD Monday (2026-06-07) we'll initiate signatures on our side. Also confirm SOC2 evidence package delivery timeline — procurement asked for a delivery estimate.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alicia
Head of Platform Eng, Solace Health
